rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone or their work is notably good, especially for skills or achievements.

example.english: Their report is remarkable—it is very well written.
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 ceot1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for something that stands out as notable or prominent, rather than simply being interesting.

example.english: Their performance is remarkable and really stands out among the whole team.
example.traditional: 佢嘅表現喺成隊人入面好突出。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 hai2 seng4 deoi6 jan4 jap6 min6 hou2 dat6 ceot1

rows.note: Use this when the point is specifically that something is worth mentioning, especially in more formal speech or writing.

example.english: One remarkable point worth mentioning about this meeting is that everyone finally reached a consensus.
example.traditional: 呢次會議有一點值得一提，就係大家終於達成共識。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 wui6 ji5 jau5 jat1 dim2 zik6 dak1 jat1 tai4 zau6 hai6 daai6 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 daat6 sing4 gung6 sik1

rows.note: Use this for something unusual or distinctive without necessarily saying that it is excellent.

example.english: The decor of this restaurant is remarkable—it is really unusual.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好特別。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 dak6 bit6
